accepted.note: Three ordered/reversed rounds; no Spark cache, OS/HDFS cache retained; one executor/core. Query timing excludes setup and result-equivalence checks; no production throughput claim.

application.note: Application timing includes executor allocation but excludes input landing and pre-Spark JVM startup. Task counters include rescans/cache work and are not source row counts or process RSS peaks.

limitations: One executor/core on one physical host; three measured rounds are not a sustained throughput guarantee
AQE disabled and broadcast threshold -1 to expose requested mechanisms, not production defaults
OS/HDFS caches retained; setup and full multiset verification outside per-query timing
Task input counters include actual column reads and repeated scans; SQL filesSize is full selected file size
Salting is slower here and adds an event_id read; do not adopt without a workload-specific benefit
Guest cgroup snapshots do not prove full driver lifetime RSS; no OOM observed at samples
